scope: Selected configuration of M1 baseline v4: the deployment checkpoint and the three seed checkpoints that protocol v4 ds2_report evaluates
decision_authority: SV1, delegated by GVHD (GVHD gave SV1 all group decisions and supports the controller)
review_evidence_form: SV1 chat message pasted by SV3 and saved verbatim as UTF-8 LF. SV1 attachments (recompute_grid.py, reload_val.py, rerun_c5.py, rerun_summary.py, rec118.py, *_out.txt, SHA256SUMS.txt) are not part of this lock

rerun_2c.note: Rerun is a repeatability check only; it is not a selection input and changes no checkpoint

reproducibility: Same-GPU reruns are bit-identical (SV3 rerun on RTX 5060; SV1 two runs on RTX 3050). Different GPUs give different models (SV1: C5 mean validation macro-F1 0.5129 on RTX 5060, 0.5516 on RTX 3050). The checkpoint files bound here are the only evidence of the model; numbers from another GPU never change them

ds2.order: Strict reading chosen by SV1: protocol v4 ds2_report.timing allows DS2 after the checkpoint lock, but quantization.freeze_before_DS2 requires the xmodel lock before any DS2 predictions and change_control.DS2 requires model/quantization lock. DS2 therefore waits until SV2 locks the SHA-256 of xmodels s0-s9 (week 13). Until then NoPeek, P2 and quantization use train/val only
ds2.passes: Then exactly one FP32 pass by SV3 and one DPU pass by SV2; no repeat evaluation
ds2.script: No DS2 script exists at 365acbc (only ds2_reporting_metrics tested on fixtures). SV1 reviews the script before any DS2 access. Required: a validation dry run of the same code path reproduces the summary confusion of all three checkpoints above; test_main and test_aux22 come from one pass; the device is recorded; per-beat predictions are saved with record_id. The exact contents of the single SV3 pass (FP32 only, or FP32 plus the INT8/FP16 emulated path of v1.2 section 4.3) are fixed in that reviewed script before DS2 access
ds2.per_record_confusion: Declared before DS2: a 5x5 confusion per record on test_main and test_aux22 is reported as a descriptive addition, not a primary or secondary metric of ds2_report and never a selection input. Reason: patient-dependent failure (record 118 on validation; RBBB records 212 and 231 are in DS2)

package_A: Delivered after this lock is committed and pushed and the GitHub Release exists, without DS2 predictions; DS2 predictions (v1.2 section 4.3) follow the xmodel SHA lock
limitations: Model instability: within one configuration validation macro-F1 ranges 0.41-0.57 across seeds; C5 - C1 = 0.0027 is within noise. Report all three seeds, not only the deployment seed, which was chosen as the highest and is therefore optimistic
No bit-exact reproduction across GPUs (RTX 5060 vs RTX 3050)

Seed C5-20261030 fails gate V. Per SV1, 2158 of the 2166 N beats predicted V are in record 118 (RBBB), record accuracy 0.7 %; on RTX 3050 the same seed partly collapses on the same record (990/995, accuracy 0.54). This is a patient-dependent weakness rather than pure chance; DS2 contains RBBB records 212 and 231, so per-record numbers are required
Validation has 4 patients: 169 of 172 S beats are in records 118 and 223; all 25 F beats are in records 205 and 223
